game_title: Call Stack Tower – Ice Market Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Ice Market, a market under icicles: the snow ranger must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Call Stack Tower: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order.
theme: Snowy Hold – Ice Market: a market under icicles
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Market, repeat each round: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the stack_height value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about stack_height to power up the snow ranger and open the hold gate.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 7 (applied tier): Call Stack Tower
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
